listing.title: The Grajales Patio - Private Poolside in Fontana
listing.description:
Whether you're looking to relax under the sun, splash and play with the family, or celebrate a special occasion, The Grajales Patio is the perfect spot for unforgettable summer moments.

Enjoy a spacious, clean, and beautifully maintained pool area that's ideal for:
- Lounging and unwinding
- Hosting small gatherings or birthdays
- Making fun summer memories

The Grajales Patio is more than just a pool - it's an experience that will exceed your expectations.

Come swim, celebrate, or simply take a break from the everyday. We can't wait to host you!

Good to know
- Up to 30 guests.
- 3-hour minimum booking.
- 24 hours advance notice required.
- Open daily 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM (Pacific).
- Children are welcome; infants are not permitted.
- No pets. No smoking.
- Parties, alcohol and amplified music are welcome.

Pick the rate for your group size when you book: 1-5 guests $35/hr, 6-10 $45/hr, 11-15 $55/hr, 16-20 $65/hr, 21-30 $85/hr.

Included at no extra charge: outdoor shower, floaties, and a fridge.

Optional add-ons (flat fee per booking): Wi-Fi $25, pool heating $200 (24-hour advance request required), BBQ grill $30, fire pit $50, speakers/sound system $50, 10 plastic chairs $20, two 6-ft tables $30.

Hosted by Bibi, a verified Swimply host since June 2025, rated 5.0 from 3 reviews. Listing details imported from her Swimply listing at her request.
